items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: he was kind of like a man who was a friend to the musicians

ctx.x: And that was on 14th Street. And now, over on 18th Street we had a Subway. Now, this is another place where we had an after hours jam session. Now, over in that area where the great Piney Brown and Felix Payne -- Felix Payne was actually the boss of all that Black neighborhood, you know. He had his connections down with whoever it was, you know.
Well, Piney Brown was what? A tavern owner?
